svg.title: The customer who vanished from your revenue report: LEFT JOIN and the NULL that sums to nothing
svg.desc: five customer nodes on a left rail, four order arrows flowing right into a revenue box, one customer node left behind with no arrow, and a broken INNER JOIN line cutting the missing customer from the total. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The customer who vanished from your revenue report: LEFT JOIN and the NULL that sums to nothing”. A isometric lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1046175516.
